name: Oujou Ibun - First part "Kare ga Shinanakereba Ikenakatta Riyuu"
original_name: 鴎城異聞 第一聞「彼が死ななければいけなかった理由」
source:
A mysterious tale of romance unfolds in Kowloon -- a walled city where there is no "sky".

Originally planned as the first part of a five-part series.
